profile.headline: Software Engineer at The Pokémon Company International
profile.summary:
Flexible and experienced senior level multiple tier/language Game Development Engineer in the Seattle, Washington area with a business eye on process improvement and quality control while consistently producing on time results on all assignments.

Languages
     C#, Many other over the years (Java, Javascript, Typescript, Lua)

Development Applications
     Unity, Perforce, Git, Rider, Visual Studio, Cursor AI, GitHub Copilot. Claude Code 

Software Development Practices
     Jira, OOP, Agile, Scrum, Certified Scrum Master, XP, Test Driven Development, nUnit, Design Driven Development, Game Design

Database Knowledge
     Design and Normalization, T-SQL

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
Core member of the client engineering team that shipped PTCG Live by our target release date.

Filled in as a producer while doing engineering work to accelerate backlog refinement and define the scope of team goals to better provide clear expectations to stakeholders.

Managed a new intern that successfully converted to full time becoming a valuable member of the team.

Lead engineer on new six month highly successful feature working with production and three other engineers to deliver on time and complete feature to production with no high priority bugs.

Moved into Line Lead Engineer role acting as a technical voice and providing leadership for my team.

positions.title: Software Development Engineer II
positions.description:
Current skills:
C#, Java, Perforce, Unity 4+5 (IOS & Android), Git, Scrum, Visual Studio (Unity integration), Mobile Game Development

Products worked on
• April 2016 - The Swift Life - Taylor Swift App
• January 2015 - April 2016 Deer Hunter 2016
• Sept 2014 - January 2015 Deer Hunter 2014 Live Team
• November 2013 - Sept 2014 Amazing Battle Creatures, New Mobile Game

Work accomplishments
• Mobile Game Development using Unity 4.x, 5.x and C#.
• Smattering of Java to support back in server work.
• Working Scrum Master for several teams
• Extensive work on tutorial systems and implementation for our mobile games
positions.insights: Skills: Constructive Feedback · Technical Specs · Documentation · Computer Science · Communication · Organization Skills

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
Products worked on
• June 2012 - August 2012  unreleased MMO game.
• August 2012 - April 2013  Disney's Club Penguin

Work accomplishments
•	Designed/implemented complex random weighted reward drop system in Lua for unreleased game with JSON based data tables and unit tests to ensure proper chance of rewards.
•	Created OO ActionScript 3 based UI and rough Flash assets that hooked into back end Lua server code to quickly prototype early UI iterations of new game.
•	Refactored and optimized existing systems written in Lua and ActionScript 3 using internal profiling software.
•	Independently created a custom Notepad++ XML file to support Disney’s proprietary Lua language additions that increased accuracy and speed across all teams using the same engine.
•	Worked with a remote team to quickly create an asset export tool using JavaScript, ActionScript 3 and Adobe’s JSFL library used for Flash automation.  Entire team of 5 engineers went from little domain experience to working tool in less than 2 months.
positions.insights: Skills: Constructive Feedback · Technical Specs · Documentation · Computer Science · Communication · Organization Skills

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Products worked on
October 2010 - March 2012  Secret Agent X (Unreleased in US)

Word Accomplishments
•	Member of engineering team that worked on unreleased Secret Agent X social game. Early beta video: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=2--_ei3v5Jk
•	Implemented and helped design many key systems including rewards, requirements for quests, inventory management in game, and custom gameplay programming.
•	Responsible for back end Lua code that hooked into front end OO ActionScript 3 code, often had to make changes to both locations to make systems work well together.
•	Spent 1 month designing and creating entire mission from outline to assist designer workload while working on other engineering tasks and to improve designer tools.
positions.insights: Skills: Constructive Feedback · Technical Specs · Documentation · Communication · Organization Skills

positions.title: Programmer Analyst II (Software Engineer)
positions.description:
•	Lead web developer responsible for all updates and maintenance on pre-existing FrontPage based web site with about 1000 hits per day at: http://www.valleyair.org
•	Lead web developer for new Dreamweaver/CSS based website at: http://www.healthyairliving.org 
•	Responsible for entire life of assigned internal projects from initial design, database design (MS SQL Server 2005-2008), documentation, implementation, training, support and maintenance written in VB.NET & ASP.NET using SDLC and ITIL process as guidance.
•	Independently presented on Scrum and ran pilot program showing proof of concept for agile methodologies and how they could help entire team hit goals more transparently and move away from waterfall driven techniques.
•	Responsible for analysis of web traffic and recommendations for which browsers to support over time.
•	Introduced jQuery to team as well as migration of existing pages from table based layout to CSS based layout.
positions.insights: Skills: Constructive Feedback · Technical Specs · Documentation · Communication · Organization Skills

positions.title: Independent Game Developer & Volunteer Community Moderator and Support
positions.description:
• Scripting in Lua to create games and modules for other users
• Asset creation in Sketchup, Blender, Photoshop, Illustrator to be used in games.
• Audio mixing in Audacity from free sound libraries.
• The 9th most visited worlds on the platform with over 9000 unique visits.
• Worked as a Volunteer Moderator, Community Content Creator, and taught official classes to new users on how to make things.
• Was one of four testers invited to visit and provide feedback to help guide the future direction of Metaplace.
• Created a fully functional Zombie game with controls similar to the Robotron arcade classic with a health bar, items usage, high score chart, and a group quest similar to Warhammer Online.
positions.insights: Skills: Constructive Feedback · Technical Specs · Documentation · Communication · Organization Skills
